xentury.bio: Xentury is a Toronto hip-hop and R&B artist whose independent catalogue connects her with the city's rap and soul community. She has recorded across the Greater Toronto Area with artists including Dan-e-o, Michie Mee and DJ Mercilless while developing her own releases and XI Entertainment. Her appearance with Masta Ace on Dan-e-o's 2024 single Cleanse My Soul is her Northern Dial library credit.

hellbent.bio: Hellbent is a Canadian dance and electronic project led by producer Vince 'Vinny Mac' Maria and vocalist-songwriter Rachelle Loren. The group built national and international radio momentum with Fast Car and later continued through club-oriented singles and remixes on Intense Records. The Ryder Remix of Fast Car is the Hellbent recording represented in the Northern Dial library.

lan'do.bio: Lan'do is a Canadian-born rapper and songwriter who was raised in Jamaica before returning to a Toronto-rooted music community. His genre-blurring solo work draws on hip-hop, dancehall and international influences, and he has also collaborated with Toronto collective No Tourists. His appearance on X10Land's 2023 single Walking With Wolves with Junia-T, Private Name Private Number, Victory and Patrik Kabongo is his Northern Dial library credit.

yessirxd.bio: YessirXD is a Montréal rapper and melodic hip-hop artist whose releases include Bad Habits, Mama Don't Worry, Pave The Way and Scars. His music blends contemporary rap with melody-driven songwriting, and he has collaborated with artists in Canada and the United Kingdom. His feature on CHINO WAWA's 2025 track FLAWS from Glue ll is his Northern Dial library credit.

doman.bio: James Doman is a Canadian house DJ, producer, songwriter and remixer whose career developed through Toronto's dance-radio and nightclub scene before expanding internationally. He became known through solo production and his partnership with British DJ Pete Gooding, including the 2009 dance single Runnin' featuring Canadian singers Dru and Lincoln. Runnin' is the Doman credit in the Northern Dial library.
